name: ozai-api-studio
description: Ozai API Studio - simple desktop API client built with Electron, React and TypeScript
//: CARA PAKAI (jalankan di terminal, dari folder project ini):
1. npm install                  -> install dependency + auto-fix signature Electron (macOS)
2. npm run dev                  -> jalankan app mode development (hot reload), buka window Ozai API Studio
3. npm run build                -> build production ke folder out/
4. npm run package             -> build + bikin installer macOS (.dmg & .zip) di folder dist/
5. npm run package:win         -> build installer/zip Windows (dijalankan dari macOS juga bisa)
6. npm run typecheck           -> cek error TypeScript tanpa build
7. npm run preview             -> preview hasil build production
8. npm run fix:electron        -> re-sign Electron dev kalau macOS blokir 'contains malware'
Sync workspace (Supabase direct Postgres): tombol Upload / Import / History di top bar.
- Upload: kirim workspace lokal + snapshot commit ke Supabase (buat tabel otomatis).
- Import via URL: tarik workspace dari URL/connection string Supabase + DB password.
- Environment variable bertanda 'secret' TIDAK ikut di-upload (value dikosongkan).
Kalau app hasil package (.app) diblokir macOS, jalankan: xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine "dist/mac-arm64/Ozai API Studio.app"
